episodes.title: The Chief of War
episodes.summary: Kaʻiana is summoned back home to Maui where he must decide whether to join King Kahekili in war.

episodes.title: Changing Tides
episodes.summary: Fearing for their lives, Kaʻiana and his family flee Oʻahu. An ally emerges with a promise of safe passage.

episodes.title: City of Flowers
episodes.summary: Kaʻiana arrives in a strange land. Kaʻahumanu takes her place beside Kamehameha.

episodes.title: City of Flowers Part II
episodes.summary: A dangerous power struggle emerges in the Kingdom of Hawaiʻi. Kamehameha wrestles with his new responsibility. Kaʻiana searches for Tony.

episodes.title: The Race of the Gods
episodes.summary: Kaʻiana returns with a warning, and a dangerous competition will determine his fate in Kamehameha's council. Keōua sends a message.

episodes.title: The Splintered Paddle
episodes.summary: Kūpuohi tries to keep the hope of peace alive as the drums of war grow louder. Kaʻiana questions Kamehameha's leadership.

episodes.title: Day of Spilled Brains
episodes.summary: A disagreement erupts about how to deal with the arrival of outsiders.

episodes.title: The Sacred Niu Grove
episodes.summary: After his worst fears come true, Kaʻiana suffers a devastating loss. Keōua's call to war becomes unavoidable for Kamehameha.

episodes.title: The Black Desert
episodes.summary: Season finale. A great battle arrives as Kaʻiana and Kamehameha lead their army against the combined might of Maui and Keōua.
